scripts.build:sync-static: tsc -b && vite build && rm -rf ../backend/static/assets && cp -r dist/* ../backend/static/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../../kalorii-ai-debug.apk
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../../kalorii-ai.apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../../backend/static/kalorii-ai.apk
